answer: Registration locks a stablecoin escrow deposit as a slashable bond: an identity costs real money. Detection runs on a per-epoch message rate limit: any agent caught spamming the network with hollow attestations is flagged. The penalty follows at once: the entire bond is destroyed at once. No identity exists without its own zenith of locked funds. One mesa, one bond: the rule leaves no room for a farm. Each fake needs its own echo, and each echo costs a full bond.
